rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040sd p. 11, Line 18: "If you checked “Yes” on line 17, complete the 28% Rate Gain Worksheet in these instructions". f1040sd p. 2, line 17: "Are lines 15 and 16 both gains? Yes. Go to line 18. No. Skip lines 18 through 21, and go to line 22." (f1040sd was not among the pages given; the i1040sd p. 11 sentence was.) Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/g28.deepseek.json; 1,159 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 40 partial bases, 0 partial records; 1,659 comparisons): 1,539 agree; 120 candidate-shows-skipped (25 on completed returns, 17 incomplete, 78 refused); no value, refusal or unknown difference. The candidate's arithmetic is the project's (the smaller of Schedule D line 7 and zero (the reply's zero is 0 minus 0); every return on which the project shows line 6 agrees), but the reply declares no shown_when, so it shows Schedule D line 7's loss on returns that never reach the worksheet; the project hides line 6 behind g28.reached (sd.line17 true; BUG-0183). Witnesses: classm.ltc.1 (completed; Schedule D line 17 No, line 7 -$1,657.00) project hidden, candidate -$1,657.00; classm.clcw26.2.deepseek (completed; line 7 -$10,701.00) project hidden, candidate -$10,701.00. Under the owner-confirmed skipped-line rule (adjudication README) a nonzero amount shown on a worksheet the filer never reaches is a defect of the side that shows it. The published interface offered shown_when ("a Bool line of the same document") and sd.line17 (Bool), so the source reading was expressible. The Stage 20 gate is confirmed on this line. Project stands.
